messages:
mira: Quick sync — support keeps getting tickets where console shows only the gateway API key, not the downstream project. Customers want per-project provenance but our dashboards go quadratic.
dev: We can't feed every identity to the metrics store. Suggest batching provenance into a compact daily rollup: per (origin_key, routed_model, region) keep counts + reservoir of eff_id_hash samples.
oliver: I like the rollup. Counts preserve billing/debugging signals, reservoir gives examples to inspect. For reservoir, keep first M traces/day per origin_key, then sample 0.5% after.
zoe: Important: storage must only ever contain hashed eff_id (HMAC prefix) so we don't store PII. Also TTL on sample examples (30d default).
mira: UX: expose a "recent provenance examples" panel on the key page with small rows of (eff_hash, route, reason), and a note "sampled". Don't add heavy filters.
dev: Need an opt-in for org admins "Include impersonated identity in UI (may increase costs)". Default false. If enabled, we include extra sample rows and slightly higher retention.
oliver: Rollout plan: stage 1 staging pilot with top 3k keys; stage 2 expand to 20k if costs look ok. We'll log estimated cost delta in the rollout doc.
zoe: And a hard guard: enforcement/quota math must always use auth-resolver counters. Put a CI test asserting sampled path is not referenced by billing code.
ops-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-rollup-prototype@staging by ci/cd at 2026-03-23T12:40:01Z
mira: Action items: dev prototype daily rollup + reservoir (PR by Thu), oliver mock UI panel + tooltip copy, zoe add eff_hash lib + security review, i'll coordinate billing signoff.
dev: One more note: include routing_reason metadata (fallback/overload/route-choice) with each sample so engineers can triage latency/fallbacks.
mira: Perfect. Keep sampling global <1% for high-volume keys but guarantee at-least-5/day for low-volume keys so owners see activity. Thanks team :thumbsup:
